events.title: Pisgah Rage Pre-season
events.description: Pre-season starts around mid-October. Includes 2-3 social events to get to know each other, rider assessment, bike shop night, parent meeting, and 1-2 adventure rides in Bent Creek or Dupont.

events.title: Pisgah Rage Regular Season
events.description: Regular season with practices and races. January: 2-4 indoor training opportunities on spin bikes and gym exercises on weekends. February: 1 weekend practice per week for 2 hours. March-May: 2 rides a week with 1-2 weeknight rides after 5pm lasting 1.5 hours and weekend day practices alternating Saturdays and Sundays lasting 2 hours. Races typically occur 5-6 times across North Carolina from beginning of March through end of May.
